targets.expr:
(
  (avg by(check_ip) (label_replace(node_load1{cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?")) * (${operation} == bool 1))
  +
  (min by(check_ip) (label_replace(node_load1{cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?")) * (${operation} == bool 2))
  +
  (max by(check_ip) (label_replace(node_load1{cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?")) * (${operation} == bool 3))
)
/ on(check_ip)
count by(check_ip) (
  group by(check_ip, cpu) (label_replace(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode="idle", cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))
)
* on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) 
avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"${node}", cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

(
  (avg by(check_ip) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster}"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?")) * (${operation} == bool 1))
  +
  (min by(check_ip) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster}"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?")) * (${operation} == bool 2))
  +
  (max by(check_ip) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster}"} - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?")) * (${operation} == bool 3))
)
/ on(check_ip)
max by(check_ip) (label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))
* on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) 
avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"${node}", cluster=~"${cluster}"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

sum by (cpu, nodename) (label_replace(irate(node_cpu_seconds_total{mode!="idle", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]), "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))) * 100

label_replace(node_load1{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

label_replace(node_load5{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

label_replace(node_load15{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

label_replace(node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} - node_memory_MemFree_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} - node_memory_Buffers_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} - node_memory_Cached_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

label_replace(node_memory_Cached_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} + node_memory_Buffers_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

label_replace(node_memory_MemFree_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

100 - (label_replace(node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?")) * 100)

label_replace(rate(node_disk_read_bytes_total{device=~"sd.*|vd.*|nvme.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]), "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

label_replace(rate(node_disk_written_bytes_total{device=~"sd.*|vd.*|nvme.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]), "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

100 - (label_replace(node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs", cluster=~"$cluster"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype=~"ext4|xfs|btrfs", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?")) * 100)

label_replace(rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|flannel.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]), "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

label_replace(rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{device!~"lo|veth.*|cali.*|flannel.*", cluster=~"$cluster"}[5m]), "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?") * on(check_ip) group_left(nodename) avg by (check_ip, nodename) (label_replace(node_uname_info{nodename=~"$node", cluster=~"$cluster"}, "check_ip", "$1", "instance", "(.*?)(:.*)?"))

panels.description: Talos node /var fill (the writable root that backs ephemeral storage, container images, proxmox-csi PVC mounts, etc.) plus a PVC inventory. Per-PVC fill % is not available: kubelet on K8s 1.34 / Talos 1.11 does not emit `kubelet_volume_stats_*` despite running the collection. For NFS-backed PVC fill watch the Synology directly; for proxmox-local watch the Proxmox host's LVM pool.

Fullest Talos node /var across the cluster. /var is the writable root for the Talos VM — backs ephemeral storage, container images, emptyDir, and proxmox-csi PVC mounts on that node. NFS PVCs do NOT show here (NAS-side capacity).
panels.title: Fullest Talos node /var

panels.description: PVC inventory across all namespaces. Requested = the `spec.resources.requests.storage` from the PVC. Actual fill is not shown — see panel notes for why.
panels.title: PVC inventory

panels.description: Free space on each Talos node's /var partition. A downward trend means the node's writable root is filling up (container images, ephemeral storage, proxmox-csi PVCs).
panels.title: Talos node /var free space
